name: NLC2CMD
description: The NLC2CMD Competition hosted at NeurIPS 2020 aimed to bring the power of natural language processing to the command line. Participants were tasked with building models that can transform descriptions of command line tasks in English to their Bash syntax. This is a report on the competition with details of the task, metrics, data, attempted solutions, and lessons learned.
reputation: A competition benchmark from NeurIPS 2020 that is known in code generation and command synthesis research, but is relatively specialized.
notes: Small competition-style dataset; exact-match to Bash syntax is strict and many semantically correct outputs may be counted wrong.
